invariants.statement: Every governed ACT outcome reaches learning through one boundary; no path writes lessons on its own.
Only a success carrying external-system assurance with an independent readback may create or reinforce a lesson.
Failed or unverified outcomes are kept as experience, recorded as failure observations, and can never raise successful-skill confidence.
The model proposes guidance only: pattern identity, observations, evidence references and confidence are derived by the runtime from governed receipts.
Only whitelisted receipt fields reach the lesson extractor; credentials and provider payloads never do.
Confidence follows evidence in both directions, and a lesson can be disputed, marked stale, or retired.
Current runtime truth outranks learned memory: a lesson whose binding facts are contradicted is withheld from reuse and the contradiction is recorded.
Learned state belongs to BRO: model and provider identity are provenance only, and learning survives a model or provider change.
Repeated evidenced success may create a skill candidate; approval and promotion remain separate explicit transitions with an append-only audit trail.
Learned knowledge is advisory context and never bypasses scope confirmation, authority evaluation, provider restriction or independent readback.
A learning-subsystem failure cannot reverse or falsify an already completed governed action receipt.
Retrieval is a pure read; filing a contradiction is a separate explicit write that may fail without hiding the finding or breaking the turn.

BRO's durable verified record is supplied above the conversation, outranking earlier chat including BRO's own previous replies; BRO may report it as prior recorded experience while never claiming to be acting now, never inventing evidence, and never treating the record as authority.

truth_boundary.repository_claim: Durable BRO-owned experience, evidence-gated lesson accumulation, evidence-aware confidence, contradiction handling, deterministic retrieval, structured skill candidates and guarded approval/promotion transitions are implemented and testable.
not_claimed: Autonomous model-weight training or fine-tuning of any kind
Arbitrary self-modifying code or automatic installation of generated code
Semantic quality of every model-derived lesson
Production learning evidence before host rollout, readback and a live governed ACT
